checks.stdout:
name: Update board

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - "data/**"
      - "generate_site.py"
      - "pgo_comparison.py"
      - "pgo_current_board.py"
      - "pgo_forecast_lab.py"
      - "docs/pgo-theme.css"
      - "pgo_forecast_snapshot.py"
      - "pgo_forecast_weekly.py"
      - "pgo_forecast_corrected.py"
      - "research/pgo_corrected_roster_candidate/*.py"
      - "docs/evidence/forecast-lab-2026/**"
      - "research/pgo_stability_blend/prospective_attestation.json"
      - "!data/snapshots.json"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write
  pages: write
  id-token: write

concurrency:
  group: board-update
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      TZ: America/New_York
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: main
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v7
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - name: Install PGO test dependency
        run: python -m pip install -r requirements-pgo.txt
      - name: Run tests (includes the editorial gate)
        run: |
          python -m unittest discover -s tests
          python -m unittest research.pgo_corrected_roster_candidate.test_candidate research.pgo_corrected_roster_candidate.test_temporal
      - name: Refresh public board without replacing approved PGO panel
        run: python pgo_comparison.py --refresh-mccabe
      - name: Render verified Forecast Lab archive
        run: python pgo_forecast_lab.py

      # --- walshja9 (canonical / LIVE site): keep the proven commit-back deploy ---
      # Its Pages source is "Deploy from a branch" (main /docs); committing docs/index.html
      # back to main is what refreshes postgameoutlet.com. Unchanged behavior.
      - name: "Commit and push if changed (walshja9 only)"
        if: github.repository == 'walshja9/Postgame_Outlet'
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add docs/index.html docs/forecast-lab.html
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "Board unchanged - nothing to commit."
          else
            git commit -m "Auto-regenerate board from data change"
            git pull --rebase origin main
            git push origin main
          fi

      # --- mccabe206-ops (testing mirror): publish via Pages ARTIFACT, no commit-back ---
      # No commit is written to main, so mccabe/main stays byte-identical to walshja9/main
      # (kills the dual-push drift). Requires: Settings > Pages > Source = "GitHub Actions".
      - name: "Upload Pages artifact (mccabe206-ops only)"
        if: github.repository == 'mccabe206-ops/Postgame_Outlet'
        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with:
          path: docs

  deploy:
    # mccabe206-ops only: deploy the uploaded artifact to its GitHub Pages testing site.
    needs: build
    if: github.repository == 'mccabe206-ops/Postgame_Outlet'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    steps:
      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4

name: Publish edition

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      label:
        description: "Edition label (e.g. Week 3)"
        required: true
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: board-update
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      TZ: America/New_York
      LABEL: ${{ inputs.label }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: main
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v7
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - name: Install PGO test dependency
        run: python -m pip install -r requirements-pgo.txt
      - name: Run tests (includes the editorial gate)
        run: python -m unittest discover -s tests
      - name: Snapshot the edition
        run: python snapshot.py "$LABEL"
      - name: Refresh public board without replacing approved PGO panel
        run: python pgo_comparison.py --refresh-mccabe
      - name: Render verified Forecast Lab archive
        run: python pgo_forecast_lab.py
      - name: Commit and push
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add data/snapshots.json docs/index.html docs/forecast-lab.html
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "Nothing changed - snapshot may already exist."
            exit 1
          fi
          git commit -m "Publish edition: $LABEL"
          git pull --rebase origin main
          git push origin main

local_windows_task_query: Get-ScheduledTask filtered TaskName, Actions.Execute, Actions.Arguments for pgo|postgame|mccabe|power.?ratings
scope: No automatic PGO refresh/registration found in live workflows or matching local task actions; browser cutoff timer exists independently.
